title: Manager Stores
description:
1. Handling the entire stores department -as Head stores
2. Handling consignments from Domestic, imports, exports Co-ordinating with Purchase team and commercial terms and Quality teams and also other intra departments
3. Handling entire team including on roles and off roles members
4. Proper safe storage of all the materials
5. Issue of all the materials with proper approvals and stock movements
6. Maintenance of all warehouses including GC ,HUSK, COAL and other consumables
7. Handling and maintaining Inventory management with proper bin card system arrangement
8. Looking of incoming and outgoing transportation services whenever necessary and required

9. Responsible to follow the SOP’s and comply with audit norms

10 Adhere with proper inspection to always match the physical and system stock

11. MIS Reports daily ,weekly and monthly and as an when required by the concern departments
